ModMetaData.name: Comm Recruiter
ModMetaData.author: Bambaryla
ModMetaData.description:
Hire pawns from friendly and neutral factions through your comms console.
Pick a faction, choose from its limited roster and pay in silver (each pawn costs its combat power). Better goodwill unlocks stronger pawn kinds and a bigger roster. Compatible with World Domination 2's raised goodwill cap. Hirees arrive a few days later, by drop pod or on foot depending on the faction's tech level, wearing only a T-shirt and pants. They work for you for 15 days, then go home.
Treat them well: deaths cost goodwill, enslaving one turns its faction hostile, and hirees who were happy enough may ask to stay for good.
With [LFS] UI Rethemed - Core active, the hire window is drawn in its theme.
